title: PixmapSettings
description: The output canvas: what hayro splits between PixmapSettings and the ctx/transform arguments of hayro::render_into. Every field is optional; an absent field means "use the default for it". This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the PixmapSettingsJson struct in src/lib.rs, not something validated against at runtime — serde's own typed deserialization there already rejects anything this schema would catch (wrong types, out-of-range numbers, unknown fields).

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Absent means the page's own width (page-info's width, truncated to whole pixels). Required when transform is present. A zero-area canvas fails the render.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Absent means the page's own height (page-info's height, truncated to whole pixels). Required when transform is present. A zero-area canvas fails the render.

transform.description: Affine transform [a, b, c, d, e, f], meaning x' = a*x + c*y + e and y' = b*x + d*y + f (the same coefficient order as kurbo::Affine). Maps upright page space - points, origin at the page's top-left corner, y pointing down, with the page's /Rotate entry and crop box already applied - to canvas pixels. Absent means the identity, i.e. one pixel per point. Nothing outside the page's crop box is drawn, whatever the transform.

bg_color.description: What the canvas is cleared to before the page is drawn. Absent means #00000000 - fully transparent black.

rgba.description: Straight (non-premultiplied) alpha, matching Go's image/color.NRGBA, not color.RGBA (which is premultiplied).
